s.g: The ma'oma'o, Gymnomyza samoensis, a large passerine bird native to Samoa.

(chess) A fairy chess piece which moves identically to the xiangqi horse, moving one square orthogonally and then one square diagonally at a 135 degree angle. Similar to the chess knight, but has more limited movement as its movement can be obstructed by an intervening piece.

of, related to, or advocating Maoism
A species of very tall, dark green-stemmed banana native to Polynesia, having large bunches of long, round fruits with dark-colored flesh.
A native of the Polynesian people who settled Hawaii.
A religious sect of central India.
(physics, historical) A general term for any hypothetical particle of which a quark or lepton is consisted; a preon.
A member of the indigenous people of New Zealand.
A member of the indigenous people of the Cook Islands.
Of, from, or pertaining to the Māori.
